title: Cemetery GPS Log Missing Coordinates
dataSources: Hints (`genealogy:hint`), cemetery visits (`genealogy:cemetery`), family-photo work (`genealogy:photo`), research ops (`genealogy:ops`).
app: Genealogy and family-history telemetry — Ancestry hints, cemetery visit logs, and photo-restoration queues — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:cemetery cemetery_name=* coordinates_present=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(coordinates_present="no",1,0))) as matched by cemetery_name
| eval missing_coordinates_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - missing_coordinates_pct
description: Measures the percentage of cemetery visit logs that end with missing coordinates by cemetery.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which cemetery are helping or hurting cemetery visit logs.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `missing coordinates` on `genealogy:cemetery` events and summarize the hit rate by `cemetery_name`.
visualization: Table of cemetery with percentage of cemetery visit logs ending with missing coordinates.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how often missing coordinates happens for each cemetery so you can see where cemetery visit logs go smoothly or get stuck.
